## Report

I have successfully redesigned the `OnboardingStyle.tsx` component to match the reference design at `/Users/naruechon/Documents/Project/OOTDay_Anti/onboarding/5.1Onboarding-Style.png`.

### Summary of Changes

**Key improvements implemented:**

- **Header redesign**: Changed from centered to left-aligned layout with red title (`--onboarding-primary`) and dark subtitle text
- **Selected thumbnails repositioned**: Moved from centered to left-aligned position directly below the header, displaying as image thumbnails with X remove buttons
- **Style cards completely redesigned**:
  - Removed thick 4px border, added subtle left red border accent (`border-l-4`) only
  - Removed "Selected" badge overlay for cleaner appearance
  - Applied `scale-110` transform to images to crop/hide baked-in text overlays
  - White background with clean, minimal styling
- **Card text layout updated**: 
  - Title formatted as "Name · Description" in red below the image
  - Added `longDescription` in gray text below title
  - Improved text hierarchy and spacing
- **Next button repositioned**: Changed from `justify-end` (right-aligned) to `justify-center` (bottom center)
- **Data source updated**: Switched from hardcoded style options to importing from `fashion-styles.json` for consistency
- **Enhanced error handling**: Added `failedImages` state and `handleImageError` function for graceful image loading failures
